verdict.rationale: For an inference engine, bulk operations mean processing many prompts at once. vLLM documents continuous batching of incoming requests and an offline inference throughput benchmark, which implies processing many requests together. However, this batching is engine-side scheduling rather than a documented user-facing bulk operation, and one community user says they had to add explicit batching support in their own client. Missing for 10: documented user-facing batch API (e.g. submitting a list of prompts or a batch job file), bulk-operation workflow docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk usage.
